gameplay: native Gameplay Football; first-person training; no PES animation bank activated
test_criteria_notes: Held-back reversals verify actual backward ball motion between samples and accepted foot events, rather than crossing the original world position before a subsequent body-relative turn.
Held-right testing allows 1200 ms per turn to include gathering the rolling ball and a real foot contact; subsequent forward input must retain the resulting front.

The backward segment in the consecutive-turn sequence permits 1.35 m at its sampling boundary; all samples must retain control and remain within 2.3 m. The following stop still requires ordinary 1.2-m reach and speed below 0.5 m/s.
